bio: Enjoy Afternoon Tea served with a colourful twist at Cinnamon Bazaar, the Indian-fusion restaurant by Cinnamon Club. Cinnamon Bazaar boasts a warm ambience that matches the vibrant flavours in their dishes.  Afternoon Tea is served in the idyllic main restaurant area.  The ceiling is adorned with draped sari fabric, hanging plants and lanterns, creating a perfectly cosy atmosphere to leisurely enjoy an Afternoon Tea.  Indulge in a beautifully presented Afternoon Tea that is unique to Cinnamon Bazaar. Afternoon Tea is reimagined as the Trader's High Tea. Finger sandwiches are replaced by fragrant treats such as a Chicken Katti Roll which can be enjoyed before tucking into inventive Chaat bites. As a finishing touch, guests can indulge in a delicious range of unique sweet treats such as a delicious cinnamon macaron and a pistachio cake with rosewater marshmellow.  This Indian twist on the quintessential classic Afternoon Tea is the collaborative work of  Vivek Singh, and Great British Bake Off star Tamal Ray, who have drawn inspiration from their shared family roots in Kolkata, West Bengal.  Cinnamon Bazaar is ideally situated in the vibrant Covent Garden area of London, just a short distance away from Charing Cross station.
